title: Grade 2 Science — Wed, Jun 11
description: Animals Around Us — Day 3 of 5: What animals eat
subject: science

questions.question: Animals that eat only plants are called:
questions.explanation: Herbivores eat only plants. Cow, deer, rabbit, and horse are herbivores.

questions.question: Animals that eat only other animals are called:
questions.explanation: Carnivores eat only meat (other animals). Lion, tiger, and eagle are carnivores.

questions.question: Animals that eat both plants and animals are called:
questions.explanation: Omnivores eat both plants and animals. Humans, bears, crows, and dogs are omnivores.

questions.question: A lion eats other animals. So the lion is a:
questions.explanation: Lions hunt and eat other animals (deer, zebra, etc.), making them carnivores.

questions.question: A cow eats grass. So the cow is a:
questions.explanation: Cows eat only grass and other plants, making them herbivores.

questions.question: Which of these animals eats both fruits and small insects?
questions.explanation: Crows eat both plant matter (fruits, grain) and animals (insects, worms), making them omnivores.

questions.question: Humans are classified as:
questions.explanation: Humans eat both plant foods (fruits, vegetables, grains) and animal foods (meat, eggs, fish) — so we are omnivores.

questions.question: Which of these is a herbivore?
questions.explanation: Elephants eat only plants — grass, leaves, fruits, and bark. They are the largest herbivores on land.

questions.question: A snake eats frogs and mice. A snake is a:
questions.explanation: Snakes eat only other animals (frogs, mice, birds), so they are carnivores.

questions.question: A deer eats only grass and leaves. A deer is a:
questions.explanation: Deer eat only plants (grass, leaves, shrubs), so they are herbivores.

questions.question: Which of these animals stores food in its cheeks?
questions.explanation: Squirrels (and hamsters) collect and store seeds and nuts in their cheeks or burrows for later eating.

questions.question: A bear eats both fish and berries. A bear is a:
questions.explanation: Bears eat fish, meat, honey, berries, and roots — both animals and plants. They are omnivores.

questions.question: Animals that only eat insects are called:
questions.explanation: Insectivores are animals that mainly eat insects. Examples: frog, chameleon, sparrow.

questions.question: What type of teeth do herbivores like cows have to grind plants?
questions.explanation: Herbivores have flat, broad molars to grind tough plant material. They lack the sharp canine teeth of carnivores.

questions.question: A dog eats both meat and vegetables. A dog is an:
questions.explanation: Dogs evolved as omnivores and can eat both meat and plant-based foods.
